lookup: Exact supplied Gateway transaction reference only; limit 1; no unfiltered account history read
authentication_conclusion: Provided token accepted by documented my.sepay.vn legacy User API; prior 401 on userapi-sandbox does not make token universally invalid.
lookup_limitation: Gateway transaction.transaction_id was used only as a candidate reference_number. Mapping to bank-ledger reference_number is not established by these docs; empty filtered result does not prove transaction absent from all User API records.
product_distinction: Bank transaction User API with Bearer token is distinct from Payment Gateway order API with Basic Auth. Gateway simulated payment cannot be assumed to appear in bank transaction API.
